regime: Split tape. NQ short below a falling stop, ES long above a rising stop. Volatility expanded on FOMC minutes day and gold ripped 4.4%. Post-event, reduced-risk posture.
summary: Quiet day-over-day for the Nasdaq, loud under the surface. NQ closed 29,559, basically flat versus Tuesday, but stayed pinned below a falling ATR stop all session, so the short regime still runs the show. The S&P did the opposite: it closed above its own rising stop. So ES reads long while NQ reads short, and that split is the story of the day. Gold stole the show with a 4.4% rip into and after the FOMC minutes, closing 4,546.8 well above a rising stop. Crude gave back about 1% but held its line near 84.11. Vol picked up, with the Nasdaq hourly ATR at 92 versus the mid-60s earlier this week.
psychology: When two things you usually treat as one start disagreeing, size down, do not force a side. ES long and NQ short at the same time is a mixed signal, and mixed signals are where over-traders lose the most. Let price pick the tie-breaker before you lean.

event.name: FOMC July 28-29 Minutes
event.actual: Held 3.50-3.75% with 3 dissenters who favored a hike
event.surprise: Hawkish-leaning read, market watched how wide the hawk camp runs
event.nqReaction: NQ stayed below its falling stop through the release and closed 29,559, essentially flat on the day but still in a short regime. The bigger move was gold, up 4.4%, with equity vol expanding as the minutes landed.
event.crossAsset: Gold ripped 4.4% to 4,546.8 (safe-haven / dovish-Fed bid), well above its rising stop. Crude eased about 1% to 84.41 but held its stop. Equity ATR expanded. VIX was not pulled this run (TrendSpider VIX is finicky per Lesson 014), so the vol read is from equity ATR expansion, not an unapproved feed.

risk.sizing: Lighter size on the index book. NQ short and ES long at once is a split signal, so favor confirmation over conviction and respect a stop reclaim on either index.
risk.openRisk: Gold just ran 4.4% and sits near its highs, so chasing the long late carries reversal risk. Crude is thin, holding its stop by only 0.30.
risk.note: Event day: FOMC minutes landed at 2:00 PM ET. Thursday brings jobless claims and the Philly Fed at 8:30 ET and Leading Indicators at 10:00 ET; flash S&P Global PMIs are Friday. Jackson Hole (Aug 27-29) is the bigger event on the horizon. Not financial advice.
